We need to determine crimes based on facts. The scenario: group forcibly went to casino to seize shares, used knives, threatened, fought, used a firecracker gun (火药枪) and caused disturbance. Likely crimes: robbery (强行从...获取股份) maybe extortion? Also illegal possession of weapon? Use of knives, firearms. Chinese criminal law: 组织、参与聚众斗殴 (聚众斗殴罪) - crime of gathering people to fight. Also illegal possession of firearms (非法持有枪支罪) maybe. Also intimidation? They used force to seize shares: could be extortion (敲诈勒索) or robbery (抢劫). They used knives to threaten, but they didn't actually take property? They attempted to seize shares in casino. That could be robbery (抢劫) because they used violence to obtain property. Also they used a firecracker gun (火药枪) which is a firearm? Might be illegal possession of firearms and ammunition. Also they organized a group to fight (聚众斗殴). Also maybe illegal possession of weapon (持械斗殴). The rule: If factual description states forcibly seized, intercepted, or took control of a vehicle, include 劫持船只、汽车. Not relevant.

If they established gambling venue: not.

Thus likely charges: 抢劫;聚众斗殴;非法持有枪支、弹药 (or illegal possession of firearms). The instruction: when multiple descriptors refer to same offense concerning firearms, merge into single combined charge phrase. So we can combine illegal possession and use of firearm? Could be “非法持有枪支、弹药”. Also they used knives, but knives are not firearms. Could be “非法持有管制刀具” but not typical.

Thus final answer list: 抢劫;聚众斗殴;非法持有枪支、弹药
